item.title: Cult of PiN
item.description:
Title: Cult of PiN
Genre: Action , Indie , Strategy
Developer: KennyMakesGames
Publisher: KennyMakesGames
Release Date: Aug 10, 2026




About This Game

Cult of PiN is a roguelike Pinball game requiring sharp reflexes and strategic combos. Collect powerful Glyphs to enhance your damage, and smash your way through as many stages as you can to claim a place on the global leaderboard.

Master the cradled ramp shot, hit hard-to-reach mission targets, and purchase run-altering mystical Glyphs to beat each table stage, destroying all the bumpers to move onto the next one. Discover hidden bonus tables and unlock new Balls and Glyphs for future runs. Perfect your nudge and trick shot skills to reach Act VI on each table to claim victory. After that, continue playing in endless mode to secure your spot on the leaderboards for each table.

A new and unique Pinball experience

Deal damage to bumpers when you hit them, and complete missions as you go to trigger encredible, table-wide damage effects

Strategic Gameplay: At higher stages, unique Table Traits and Bumper variants start appearing, forcing you to change up your approach if you want to beat the stage

Play all 4 Tables across 6 difficulty settings, each adding a new challenge to the way the game is played.

  • 100 unlockable Gylphs, each with a unique impact on gameplay

  • 4 unique Tables

  • 16 bumper types that impact gameplay, from changing gravity to moving position, or just blinking out of sight entirely

  • 8 Balls with unique rules and speeds

  • 8 Random Table traits that subvert the rules for the rest of the run!

Completed every table, on every difficulty? No problem! There's also 2 global leaderboards for each table - 'Monthly' and 'All-Time' so there's plenty of opportunity to prove yourself internationally as one of the all time PiN-ball greats

item.title: Pax Autocratica
item.description:
Title: Pax Autocratica
Genre: Action , Indie , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Multiverse
Publisher: Multiverse
Franchise: Pax Autocratica
Release Date: Aug 10, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Aug 10, 2026




About This Game

Establish the greatest regime in history in this darkly satirical colony sim and FPS roguelite hybrid. Build a prosperous totalitarian state, enforce policies, and lead your troops into first-person battles that grow from desperate skirmishes into large-scale mechanized war.

Dictate wisely. Every choice shapes society, for better or worse.

Mold your citizens through fear, propaganda, surveillance, punishment or rule as a benevolent leader through comfort and prosperity.

While they work for the State, they may grow grateful, afraid, loyal, or quietly rebellious, until dissent becomes revolt.

Venture into the fractured territories of the Tyris System to gather resources, conscript new citizens, trade with wandering merchants, and feed the growth of your colony.

Fight beside your troops in roguelite FPS battles, from hostile ships to large-scale mechanized battlefields of infantry, tanks, and mechs, spreading your doctrine and eliminating threats to humanity.

Weakened foes can be captured and dragged back to your base.

Behind prison doors, resistance can be crushed through fear, indoctrination, execution, or conversion, until an enemy becomes a citizen, a warning to would-be rebels, or another tool of the regime.

Elite enemies, bosses, and Sector Overlords flood the battlefield with bullets, lasers, missiles, drones, artillery, and overlapping projectile patterns.

This is war at scale, but you are not alone. Order your troops to secure victory, or use them as expendable shields to achieve your ends.

Turn a handful of survivors into a vast, tightly run, self-sustaining colony.

Assign citizens to mine, gather, haul, research, and manufacture weapons, armor, food, and supplies. Watch fragile shelters become the machinery of the State.

Collect roguelite cores during each expedition to grow stronger, survive longer, and push deeper into enemy territory.

Weapon Cores reshape how your guns handle. Combination Cores create synergies between different core sets. Others strengthen the troops fighting beside you, or turn them into sacrificial shields for your survival.

Each run becomes a shifting war machine built around you, your squad, and the chaos you unleash together.

Pax Autocratica is a totalitarian colony sim and FPS roguelite hybrid that combines base building, citizen management, and first-person chaotic battlefields filled with infantry, vehicles and bullet hell. It offers a dynamic, accessible, and approachable gameplay experience for all in a sci-fi dystopian world.

It’s a game about power. How it’s built, how it corrupts, and how it consumes.

You will command armies, dictate laws, and witness consequences in every face that salutes you or fears you.

THE STATE OBSERVES ALL

How will history remember your reign?

WARNING

This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: WINDOWS® 10 (64-BIT Required)
    • Processor: Intel i5-8600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600x
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: 1080p: Nvidia® GTX 1060 6G / RX 480 (6GB+ of VRAM) | 1440p: Nvidia® GTX 1070 8G / AMD Radeon RX Vega 56 (8GB+ of VRAM)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 40 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: WINDOWS® 10 (64-BIT Required)
    • Processor: Intel i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia® GTX 2060 Super / RX 5700 XT (8GB+ of VRAM)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 40 GB available space

item.title: Hole Is Mine
item.description:
Title: Hole Is Mine
Genre: Adventure , Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Incrementalist
Publisher: Incrementalist , SpaceJazz
Release Date: Aug 10, 2026




About This Game

Hole Is Mine is an incremental adventure about purifying a divine Hole. Dive inside and launch your Mini'Ohs to mine for you. Extract impurities, upgrade your power, and find hidden secrets to grow the Village, customizing your Mini'Ohs with incredible powers. The Hole Has Spoken!

Break the Hole to extract its impurities!

Use Shelly to drill your way down while managing and caring for your Mini'Ohs .

Find secrets within the Depths, rebuild the Village and grow the community!

Equip your Mini'Ohs to grant them incredible powers. Experiment and find the best combinations!

Keep going down while numbers go up .

Together, we are stronger!

Features

  • Addictive incremental progression.

  • 40~ Depths with dangers and secrets to find.

  • Customize and build your Mini'Ohs with 500+ different equipment combinations.

  • 300+ upgrades to discover.

  • Accompany your Mini'Ohs in the search of truth! (~5.0h of gameplay).

Discord

Join our Discord server to stay up to date with the latest news and share your feedback with us. You can find the link in the sidebar!

item.title: GRAIN ROT
item.description:
Title: GRAIN ROT
Genre: Action , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Beck & Branch Games
Publisher: Neem Interactive
Release Date: Aug 7, 2026




About This Game

You are a Living Spark surviving inside fragile wooden vessels that splinter, collapse, and catch fire. When your vessel breaks, the Spark escapes. Death is just a change of scenery.

Ride a cursed elevator into shifting underground ruins with your crew. Smash furniture for resources or feed them into the Grinder for gold. If everyone breaks, your loot is lost.

Trolling can become your friend’s demise. Dropkick enemies or “accidentally” launch your ally’s Spark out of their vessel. Block them in a monster-infested corridor or get stuck in the crossfire. Will your group handle the chaos you created yourselves?

The deeper you go, the worse the Rot becomes. Bodies warp. Voices distort. Emotes become…worse. Or possibly better?

The Deep Layers are filled with Corrupted vessels, reacting to sound, movement, and each other in ways that are impossible to predict. Fight. Build. Run. Panic.

When your vessel breaks, you stay in the run as a Spark . Guide your team through the dark and search for another host with a new set of abilities. Force your way back in before you fade out completely.

Everything you haul back rebuilds your Outpost. Unlock interactive furniture, stat upgrades, rescued survivors, and stranger ways to survive the next descent. The stronger the outpost becomes, the deeper you can afford to go.

Go deeper. Extract more. Leave someone behind. Make it back and build together.

Or don’t come back at all.

FEATURES

  • Possess and swap between fragile wooden vessels

  • Co-op extraction horror with physics-driven chaos

  • Tactical carpentry with interactive furniture

  • Procedurally shifting underground dungeons

  • Persistent Outpost rebuilding and progression

  • Rage-bait your friends with cursed emotes

  • Rescue survivors trapped in the Deep Layers

  • Body corruption and mutation systems

  • Questionable cosmetics
